purpose: Teach: 艦隊/傲慢/天体/ホームレス/天下り/君が代/樹木/爆撃

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、近世の艦隊戦略の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper covered modern naval fleet strategy, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Steady opening. A genuine question, not a test—she's checking in on the student's work with real interest. Quiet confidence in her own knowledge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、独裁者の傲慢さの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the arrogance of dictatorial regimes.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A slight pause before the thesis statement, as if Sakura is watching to see if the teacher catches the misdirection. Respectful but with an undercurrent of testing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 天体観測の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined the history of astronomical observation in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, curious. She's leaning slightly forward into the question. A moment of pause before 'astronomical'—she's looking at Sakura, reading her reaction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、都市部のホームレス問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I explored homelessness in urban areas.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. Eyes level. No apology, no softening. This is what she wrote, and she's holding the line. A slight sharpness underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 官僚の天下り問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper was on the bureaucratic practice of amakudari, the revolving door of retirement placements?
lines.style: Alert now. A slight shift in her posture—she's fully present. The question is longer, more careful. She's no longer matching Sakura's brevity; she's circling something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国歌「君が代」の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the history and meaning of the national anthem, 'Kimigayo.'
lines.style: Calm but pointed. The final word lands with intention. No rush. She's meeting the teacher's attention head-on. There's something deliberate in her composure.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市の樹木保全を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered urban tree conservation efforts in your research?
lines.style: A beat of recognition. Softer now—she understands what Sakura has been doing. The question is gentle but not patronizing. There's respect in the reframing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、第二次大戦中の都市爆撃を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined the bombing campaigns against Japanese cities during the Second World War.
lines.style: Quiet, steady finish. No elaboration. She's made her point. The words settle into the room. There's a dignity in the simplicity and a weight in the silence that follows.
